proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9321 *bōll gives regional bol-/boḷ- “speak” and distinguishes a separate causative. The simple imperative/past bolal/bolau variants support this speak family; initial y in yolā needs a local sound account. Reviewed comparator: Buksa bola “speak!; he spoke” (f_3qkiphn542gqs). Any uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages remains open under the user’s preference; source phonetic details are preserved.
